planets.name: HAT-P-30 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-30 with a 2.81-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-30 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-30. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2011, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.8106007, pl_radj 1.44, pl_bmassj 0.83

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
